mark-skwarek--bottomless-pit.why_en: A virtual hole in a San Jose plaza goes straight through the Earth, and people drop things into it to reach the other side.
mark-skwarek--bottomless-pit.why_zh: 圣何塞广场上的一个虚拟洞口直通地球另一端，人们往里扔东西，让它们掉到对跖点。

mark-skwarek--erasar-statue-of-liberty.why_en: Point a phone at Liberty Island and the Statue of Liberty is gone, leaving only her empty pedestal.
mark-skwarek--erasar-statue-of-liberty.why_zh: 把手机对准自由岛，自由女神像消失了，只剩下空空的底座。

frieder-weiss--shadows.why_en: A dancer's shadow is drawn by a computer, so it lags, mirrors and finally walks away from her.
frieder-weiss--shadows.why_zh: 舞者的影子由电脑画出，于是它会迟到、会反着动，最后干脆离她而去。

joon-moon--augmented-shadow.why_en: Plain white blocks cast shadows in which little houses, trees and people grow and live.
joon-moon--augmented-shadow.why_zh: 普通的白色积木投下影子，影子里长出小房子、树和小人，过着自己的生活。

cyril-diagne--super-mario-brush.why_en: A Super Mario level drawn by a child on paper becomes the level Mario actually runs on.
cyril-diagne--super-mario-brush.why_zh: 孩子在纸上画的超级马里奥关卡，直接变成马里奥真正在上面跑的关卡。

nathan-shafer--exit-glacier-ar-terminus.why_en: In an empty Alaskan valley, the ice of Exit Glacier rises again where its edge stood decades ago.
nathan-shafer--exit-glacier-ar-terminus.why_zh: 在阿拉斯加空荡荡的山谷里，Exit Glacier 的冰重新升起，回到几十年前冰川边缘所在的位置。

sander-veenhof--de-surveillance.why_en: Hold up something blue and you vanish from a police surveillance camera's screen.
sander-veenhof--de-surveillance.why_zh: 举起一块蓝色的东西，你就从警方监控摄像头的画面里消失了。

geoffrey-alan-rhodes--mao-wants-this-dol.why_en: Any dollar bill seen through a phone turns into an IOU in which Mao says the United States owes China one dollar.
geoffrey-alan-rhodes--mao-wants-this-dol.why_zh: 透过手机看任何一张美元，它都会变成一张欠条，毛泽东宣布美国欠中国一美元。

euphrates--ballet-rotoscope.why_en: Glowing curves and figures traced over a ballerina reveal the geometry hidden in every pose.
euphrates--ballet-rotoscope.why_zh: 在芭蕾舞者身上描出的发光曲线和几何图形，揭示了每个姿态里隐藏的几何。

lily-honglei--great-firewall-and-sunken-.why_en: The Great Firewall becomes a real wall that blocks a Brooklyn street for anyone looking through a phone.
lily-honglei--great-firewall-and-sunken-.why_zh: “防火长城”变成一堵真的墙，挡住了布鲁克林的一条街，只要透过手机看就能看到。

tamiko-thiel--waterlily-invasion.why_en: Water lilies that feed on your gaze grow over you the longer you look at them through the phone.
tamiko-thiel--waterlily-invasion.why_zh: 这些睡莲以你的目光为食，你透过手机看得越久，它们就长得越大，直到把你吞没。
